Questions

Do I need to buy a computer or a scanner?
No. CaratCloud runs on the phone, tablet or computer you already have. The phone camera scans the QR labels, so no scanner machine is needed.
Does it work without internet?
Yes. Billing, scanning and printing keep working when the internet is down, and everything syncs on its own once you are back online.
Which languages does it support?
Marathi, Hindi and English. You and each staff member can pick a language, and bills can be printed in it too.
Which plan should I choose?
Starter is enough for a small counter. Standard adds returns, stock checks, CA reports and staff logins. Plus adds orders, girvi, old gold stock, gram schemes and Tally files. You can move up any time.
Is there a discount for paying yearly?
Yes. Standard paid yearly is ₹8,789 (1 month free) and Plus paid yearly is ₹12,990 (2 months free). Taxes are extra.
Is my data safe and private?
Each shop's data is kept separate from every other shop. Staff only see what the owner allows, and bills are locked once saved.
What do the social media packages include?
Social Basic (₹3,499 a month) gives one shoot a week and 4 reels a month. Social Plus (₹5,499 a month) adds a daily gold rate post, two shoots a week and 8 reels a month. We shoot, edit and post for you.
Is there a referral offer?
Yes. Refer another jewellery shop, and when they start using CaratCloud, you get one month of your software plan free. There is no limit on referrals.
Do you make software for restaurants, hotels or cafés?
Yes. CaratCloud Dine, our restaurant software, launches in January 2027. Message us on WhatsApp to join the early-access list.
Can you build custom software for my business?
Yes. CaratCloud is a software company. Tell us how your business works and we will suggest an app or website, give you a clear price, build it and support it.
